summary.text: Charles Schwertner is a Republican member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 5 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He chairs the Senate Business & Commerce Committee and previously served in the Texas House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Schwertner represented District 20 in the Texas House of Representatives from 2011 to 2013 and assumed office in the State Senate in 2013, according to Ballotpedia.
In 2023-2024 he chaired the Business & Commerce Committee and was also assigned to the Finance and Senate State Affairs committees, along with the Committee of the Whole Senate.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
Schwertner and his wife, Belinda, have three children.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Schwertner said he authored Texas' 287(g) immigration enforcement law, which requires sheriffs to enter agreements with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, and that he passed laws on prayer and the Ten Commandments in classrooms and on DEI programs.
He said his priorities include continued property tax reductions and, as chairman of the Business & Commerce Committee, ensuring reliable and affordable electricity.
